channel.title: Full-Stack on Vibe Coding
channel.description: Recent content in Full-Stack on Vibe Coding

item.title: Bolt.new
item.description: Bolt.new runs entirely in the browser using WebContainers, so the generated app boots, installs npm packages, and runs without any server round-trip. You can prompt changes and watch the live app update instantly.

item.title: Lovable
item.description: Lovable is built for people who want to go from an idea to a working product without writing code themselves — you describe the app conversationally, and it scaffolds the frontend, backend, and database, with a visual editor layered on top for tweaks.

item.title: Chef
item.description: Chef is Convex’s prompt-to-app builder, distinguished from most “vibecoding” app generators by actually understanding backend concerns: it scaffolds a real Convex database schema, server functions, and authentication alongside the frontend, rather than generating UI backed by mock data.

item.title: Same.new
item.description: Same.new generates full-stack web apps from a prompt, a screenshot, or a reference URL, with the URL-to-app path in particular built to closely reproduce an existing site’s look and structure rather than a loose approximation. It defaults to Next.js so frontend and backend logic live in one codebase.

item.title: Softgen
item.description: Softgen generates full-stack web apps — UI, backend logic, and database — from a chat interface, aimed at founders and builders who want to go from idea to working product without hand-writing the initial implementation.

item.title: Base44
item.description: Base44 lets non-developers describe a product idea in chat and get back a working, hosted application with a database, authentication, and integrations already wired up, without touching code or assembling separate services.

item.title: Emergent
item.description: Emergent builds working full-stack applications from a described idea, handling frontend, backend, and data layer generation in one flow so builders can go from prompt to a functioning app without assembling separate tools.

item.title: Databutton
item.description: Databutton pairs a chat-driven agent with a workspace for building internal tools, dashboards, and small full-stack apps, generating Python backends and React frontends and handling hosting so teams can ship without setting up infrastructure.
